description: Chart on book p. 342 (PMBA-6). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the subject; MTH (methodology) is the partner. From PRI-INFO: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From AFI: EXP-CONT-1 (expansion condition (composite focus)). From EXP-CONT-1: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From SCI-DY: TECH-DY (technological dynamics). A short line from the TECH-DY line ends in a dot with no label. The page text says: "The progressional continuance of black creative music in the forties can clearly be looked at as dynamic in every sense of the word."
